items.prompt: Mika has 3 times as many coins as Nia. Together they have 80 coins. Build the model and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Nia has the smaller amount, so she gets 1 unit.
Mika gets 3 units, so there are 4 units in all.
items.explanation: 80 divided by 4 is 20, so one unit is 20 coins. Nia has 20 coins and Mika has 60.

items.prompt: Oka has twice as many marbles as Pia, and 30 more than Pia. Build the model and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Pia has the smaller amount, so she gets 1 unit.
Oka has twice as many, so he gets 2 units.
The extra unit that Oka has is worth 30 marbles.
items.explanation: Oka has 1 unit more than Pia, and that unit is 30 marbles. So Pia has 30 and Oka has 60.
